rows.en:
(Today I'm eating at Nyan-Nyan
with Claire-senpai!)

\p-kun,
did I keep you waiting?

No, I just got here myself.
Let's head in right away!
Yeah, I'm gonna eat a lot~
Phew~ I'm stuffed!

Senpai, you sure can eat a lot.
I'd never have guessed from looking at you.
What? Is something wrong with eating!?
N-no... that's not what I meant!!
Hehehe, just kidding!
Well then, let's come eat here again.
(I'm stuffed today~)

(Today I'm eating at Nyan-Nyan
with Claire-senpai!)

\p-chan,
did I keep you waiting a bit?

No, I just got here too.
Let's head in right away!

N-no... that's not what I meant.
I was just thinking you eat so much and still
have such a great figure...!

(Eating at Nyan-Nyan with Claire-senpai
again today!)
Sorry to keep you waiting, \p-kun.

I just got here myself.
Let's head in right away!

You eat with such gusto, Senpai.
It's a pleasure to watch.

...What? Is something wrong with eating
that much!?

(Eating at Nyan-Nyan with Claire-senpai
again today!)
Sorry to keep you waiting, \p-chan~

I just got here myself, so let's head in
right away.
Yeah, I'm gonna eat a lot again today~
I'm stuffed too!
So you're a big eater too, \p-chan...

Y-you think so...?
I'd better be careful...
(I'm stuffed today~)

(Today I came to Central Park
with Claire-senpai!)
The sunshine feels so nice...
It's kind of soothing, isn't it?
Hey, hey, let's take a little walk.
That was a nice change of pace.
I got to relax a lot too.

Walking around in nature isn't bad
once in a while.
Yes! Can I invite you again?
Yes, of course.
(Today was so soothing.)

(Today I came to Central Park
with Claire-senpai.)
It's kind of soothing here, isn't it?
I got to relax a lot too.

Walking around in nature isn't bad
once in a while.

(I came to Central Park with Claire-senpai
again today!)

The sunshine feels nice here,
no matter when you come...
It's so soothing, isn't it?
Let's take a little stroll, shall we?
That was another nice change of pace today.
It was soothing for me too.
Walking in nature is important, isn't it...
Yes! I'll invite you again.
Promise?

(I came to Central Park with Claire-senpai
again today.)

(Today I came to the artificial island
with Claire-senpai!)
rows.notes: Male only. 'the artificial island' as in c04386, c05039.

rows.en:
The sun is so strong. I need to put
on sunscreen.
Y-yeah, you do... *gulp*...

Oh my~ What are you imagining?
What a dirty-minded boy!
I-I'm not imagining anything!
Today was fun too~
Yes! I had fun too.
Let's come again.
(Today was fun all day long.)

(Today I came to the artificial island
with Claire-senpai.)

The sun is so strong. I need to put
on sunscreen...
Will you help me put it on my back again?
I had fun too!

(I came to the artificial island
with Claire-senpai again today!)

The sun is as harsh as ever.
If I don't put on sunscreen, I'll burn red...
Oh my~ Just what is this boy imagining?
What a dirty-minded boy...
(I'm so nervous~)
rows.notes: Female only; she is about to help with the sunscreen.
